title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN . 4 weeks ago. Be among the first 25 applicants. Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

LEDN is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients. Our team is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds who share the conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are building, innovating and revolutionizing financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will need to be highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who wants to be part of a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. This role reports to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • Be customer-facing and the first line of support; own support experience for employees via Slack, Jira, etc.
  • Provision and deliver technology equipment; own onboarding and offboarding experiences
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to knowledge base
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.)
  • Manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf)
  • Contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks
  • Manage incidents end-to-end; prioritize and resolve tickets; work on projects over sprints (Agile)
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite)
  • Ability to create automations using Bash, Zsh, Python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki)
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; work with APIs to integrate systems
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; knowledge of hardware shipping and customs
  • Strong communication skills; clear writing for tickets, email, and Slack
  • Clear, friendly, concise communication; sensitivity to different cultures
  • Security-minded mindset; understanding of PGP; basic networking and OSI model troubleshooting
  • Ability to self-manage and scope projects across multiple teams

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS
  • Experience with GAM and command-line workflows to increase efficiency
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications
  • Culture fit: thrives in startup/tech environment and embodies company values

Culture and Benefits

  • Leadership mindset with adaptability, resilience, and ability to navigate ambiguity
  • Collaborative partner across functions and cultures; empathetic and clear communication
  • Integrity and accountability in handling confidential information
  • Remote-first environment; opportunity to work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days
  • Comprehensive total rewards package, competitive PTO, and equity
  • Purpose-driven work in a digital asset company

Equal Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer and value inclusivity and diversity. For accommodation requests throughout the recruitment process, please email the Ledn team. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Additional Information

Ledn is global, remote-first, with applicants from North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high volume of applications, only those who qualify will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. You Bring to Ledn

7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite. Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc. Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc. You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You\'ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you\'re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs. Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it\'s in tickets, email or Slack.

You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone\'s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit). Culture Fit: We\'re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices. Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity. Overview

CRA II - Sponsor dedicated - Brazil Home Based

Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities. Our Clinical Development model brings the customer and the patient to the center of everything that we do. We are continuously looking for ways to simplify and streamline our work to not only make Syneos Health easier to work with, but to make us easier to work for. Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to accelerate the delivery of therapies, because we are passionate to change lives. Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know: WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Responsibilities

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required. For Real World Late Phase, the CRA II will use the business card title of Site Management Associate II. Additional responsibilities include: Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out. Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs. Chart abstraction activities and data collection Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff. The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff. Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager. Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and Health Care Provider (HCP) associations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis
  • US ONLY: As part of your employment with Syneos Health, you may be deployed to Sites that require certain medical and other personal information to gain facility access. Pursuant to our Employee Privacy Notice, Syneos Health can provide the Sites with the information necessary for you to gain such access. Further, a Site may ask you for additional information beyond that which Syneos Health has in its possession. You are required to comply with any such Site requests as a condition of your employment with Syneos Health. Please note that failure to provide requested information may result in a Site barring you from entry, which could put your ongoing employment at risk.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Employment type

Job function

description:
About Ledn

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Our team is diverse and committed to democratizing access to the global economy through our products and services.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are building, innovating, and revolutionizing financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full‑time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated experience in similar roles within rapidly growing, security‑first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code. You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud‑first infrastructure and networks. You should be adaptable, a strong communicator, and eager to grow IT skills in a fast‑moving, execution‑oriented team.

This role reports to the Director of IT. You will be customer‑facing and act as the first line of support for employees via channels like Slack and Jira. We’re primarily Mac environments, and you will manage procurement, onboarding, and lifecycle of technology equipment. You will contribute to documentation, policies, and improvements to our knowledge base, and you will manage SaaS applications including Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, and related tools. You will manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools and contribute to IDP/SSO improvements (GSuite, Okta, etc.).

You will work on projects across sprints, document your work in Jira, and align objectives with team and company goals. You will set and pursue your own objectives and key results with minimal direction while collaborating with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholders across Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; knowledge of APIs and system integrations
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; handling hardware shipping/receiving and customs
  • Exceptional communication skills across all media; clear writing for tickets, email, and Slack
  • Strong troubleshooting skills, enterprise macOS experience, and ability to work independently
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and OSI model; ability to troubleshoot methodically
  • Self-management and the ability to scope projects and work across multiple teams

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS
  • Experience using GAM and command‑line tools to increase efficiency
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications
  • Culture fit: thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies Ledn values

Culture Fit

  • Demonstrates integrity and accountability with confidential information
  • Collaborative partner across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity
  • Experience working in a remote environment and navigating ambiguity

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company through equity
  • Remote-friendly policy allowing work from anywhere globally for up to 180 days per year
  • A purpose-driven career and a commitment to removing barriers so you can do your best work

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment: Our team is global, remote-first, and spans North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, and we do not accept unsolicited resumes.

Deseja trabalhar em um lugar que concilie desafio, agilidade e inovação? Aqui é o lugar.

A área de Produto Digital é responsável por evoluir os produtos da empresa, garantindo alta performance, experiência do usuário diferenciada e integração com os demais. Temos como objetivo aumentar a adoção, engajamento e satisfação dos usuários, assegurando entregas alinhadas às estratégias de negócio e à qualidade técnica esperada.

Principais atividades:

Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog da squad, garantindo clareza e alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos.

Análise de mercado e Bench com identificação de tendências de aplicativos e canais digitais.

Escrever histórias de usuário bem definidas e critérios de aceitação claros.

Validar hipóteses e funcionalidades junto aos usuários, buscando melhorias contínuas.

Gerenciar os stakeholders e garantir a comunicação (estratégias e ações).

Buscamos alguém que apresente:

Necessário graduação completa.

Necessário domínio do Pacote Office.

Necessário conhecimento em ferramentas de apoio a gestão de projetos e produtos.

Necessário conhecimento em Scrum e frameworks ágeis.

Experiência prévia como Product Owner ou posição similar, com atuação em produtos digitais.

Vivência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis (iOS e Android).

Habilidade em análise de métricas de produto (Firebase, App Store Connect, Google Play Console).

Boa comunicação e capacidade de articular diferentes áreas e stakeholders.

Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.

Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Ledn aims to be an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment and work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR). The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We are primarily Mac environments. You will procure and deliver technology equipment and manage tech onboarding for new employees and tech retrieval for departing employees.

You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications such as Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta). You will create solution documentation and automation to reduce manual work. You will manage incidents and tickets, prioritize workload, and participate in projects over sprints using Jira and agile methods. You will set objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn: 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite). Automation skills (bash, zsh, python). Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.). Ability to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows, and work with APIs to connect systems. Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs. Excellent written and verbal communication across media. Ability to draft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages. Comfort with security principles and basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, OSI model). Self-management with the ability to scope work and coordinate across teams. Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfort with ambiguity.

Nice to Have: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace). Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability, empathy, and a collaborative approach in a remote, fast-paced environment.

What We Provide

Comprehensive total rewards package, remote-friendly with up to 180 days remote eligibility (subject to restrictions); ownership in the company through equity; a purpose-driven career; inclusive, diverse, and equal opportunity employer. We welcome accommodation requests via email for recruitment process stages; responses are confidential.

Company and Hiring Notes

Ledn’s team is global, remote-first, with presence across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes.

  • S3 (data lake, versionamento, segurança com KMS/IAM)

  • Proficiência em Apache Spark (PySpark, SparkSQL) , com tuning de memória e partições.
  • Experiência com formatos otimizados (Parquet, ORC, Avro) e compressões (Snappy, Gzip).
  • Infraestrutura, Automação e Observabilidade
  • Monitoramento e observabilidade : logs estruturados, métricas e alertas proativos.
  • Banco de Dados e SQL
  • SQL avançado (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, agregações em escala).
  • Experiência com Athena e bancos relacionais de alta volumetria (PostgreSQL ou similares).

Transformando mercados com tecnologia há mais de 30 anos. Nós impactamos vidas através da Tecnologia.

Fomos pioneiros na digitalização da Justiça brasileira e seguimos expandindo os limites do que é possível com Inteligência Artificial.

Estamos desenvolvendo um produto de alto impacto para a Justiça , que combina IA generativa, segurança de dados e arquitetura escalável para apoiar magistrados e tribunais em decisões mais céleres, consistentes e explicáveis.

É um desafio inédito: aplicar IA de ponta em escala nacional, com rigor técnico, responsabilidade e impacto direto na vida de milhões de cidadãos.

Além da engenharia, buscamos alguém com perfil de evangelização técnica — capaz de documentar entregas e descobertas, apresentar resultados em fóruns internos e externos, compartilhar boas práticas e contribuir para disseminar uma cultura de IA ética, segura e orientada a impacto.

Você fará parte da equipe que está construindo uma das arquiteturas de IA mais avançadas já aplicadas ao sistema de Justiça .

O projeto combina múltiplas camadas tecnológicas, vetorização semântica, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), multi-LLMs e pipelines distribuídos, para compreender grandes volumes de dados jurídicos de forma segura e explicável.

O impacto vai além da tecnologia: cada decisão apoiada pela nossa IA pode representar mais eficiência, menos morosidade e mais acesso à Justiça para a sociedade.

É uma jornada que une ciência de dados, engenharia de alta performance e ética no uso da IA, buscando profissionais que queiram atuar na fronteira entre inovação tecnológica e transformação pública.

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

Responsibilities

  • Join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT and be customer-facing, owning support for employees via Slack, Jira, etc.
  • Support end users, manage endpoints, automate identity and access management, and administer cloud-based IT systems and tools.
  • Design, implement and manage a growing cloud-first corporate infrastructure and networks; adapt to an evolving corporate environment.
  • Collaborate with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering, HR) and communicate effectively across the organization.
  • Procuring and delivering technology equipment; oversee onboarding and offboarding experiences for employees.
  • Develop and document programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to knowledge base.
  • Manage SaaS applications including Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.; manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM).
  • Own improvements to IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) and write helpful tickets, articles and automated workflows.
  • Handle incidents and issues to resolution; prioritize help desk tickets and work on projects over sprints using agile methods (Jira).
  • Set and pursue own objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using Bash, Zsh, Python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; experience with APIs and system integrations.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to convey ideas clearly and empathetically.
  • Security-minded approach and knowledge of PGP; understanding of networking fundamentals and OSI troubleshooting.
  • Self-management, strong organizational skills, and ability to prioritize across multiple teams; comfortable working in ambiguity.

Nice To Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS.
  • Experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to streamline tasks.
  • Certifications in Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace.

Culture & Benefits

  • We value adaptability, resilience, and a builder's mindset to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Remote-friendly environment; opportunities for global collaboration and growth; equity ownership and a comprehensive rewards package.
  • Equal opportunity employer; accommodations available during recruitment; limited agency involvement.

Additional Information

Equal opportunity employment; Ledn is remote-first and operates globally. We may ask shortlisted candidates to submit a short video and review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for related fees.

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds who share the conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are building Ledn to be an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You should be passionate about innovation and creative problem solving, and adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. This role requires a highly motivated, dependable technologist who shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

What You’ll Do

  • Be customer-facing and the first line of support; own support and provide an outstanding experience to employees via tools such as Slack and Jira.
  • Support macOS in an enterprise setting; procure and deliver technology equipment; own onboarding and offboarding experiences.
  • Design, test, build, document programs and policies, and contribute improvements to knowledge resources.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM with Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and improve IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Manage incidents and issues to resolution; prioritize help desk tickets; work on projects over sprints with Jira (agile methods).
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc., and to use open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and creating workflows in Okta; working with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; handling hardware shipping and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication across all media; ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email and Slack; clear, friendly, concise communication sensitive to different cultures.
  • Security-minded with understanding of PGP; knowledge of networking fundamentals and OSI model troubleshooting; ability to self-manage and scope projects across teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We look for more than operational excellence — a leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will be adaptable, resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth environment; possess a builder’s mindset; be a collaborative partner who can influence across functions with empathy and clarity; demonstrate integrity and accountability; and have remote-work experience.

What We Provide

  • Competitive total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a PTO package and equity ownership in the company.
  • Remote-work opportunity up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a focus on removing barriers so you love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity.

Equal Opportunity and Recruitment Notes

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. We are a remote-first, global team and do not accept unsolicited agency resumes. We may request a short video response or review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. Due to high application volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. No agencies or recruiters, please.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds who share the conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are building Ledn to be an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You should be passionate about innovation and creative problem solving, and adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. This role requires a highly motivated, dependable technologist who shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

What You’ll Do

  • Be customer-facing and the first line of support; own support and provide an outstanding experience to employees via tools such as Slack and Jira.
  • Support macOS in an enterprise setting; procure and deliver technology equipment; own onboarding and offboarding experiences.
  • Design, test, build, document programs and policies, and contribute improvements to knowledge resources.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM with Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and improve IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Manage incidents and issues to resolution; prioritize help desk tickets; work on projects over sprints with Jira (agile methods).
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc., and to use open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and creating workflows in Okta; working with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; handling hardware shipping and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication across all media; ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email and Slack; clear, friendly, concise communication sensitive to different cultures.
  • Security-minded with understanding of PGP; knowledge of networking fundamentals and OSI model troubleshooting; ability to self-manage and scope projects across teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We look for more than operational excellence — a leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will be adaptable, resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth environment; possess a builder’s mindset; be a collaborative partner who can influence across functions with empathy and clarity; demonstrate integrity and accountability; and have remote-work experience.

What We Provide

  • Competitive total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a PTO package and equity ownership in the company.
  • Remote-work opportunity up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a focus on removing barriers so you love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity.

Equal Opportunity and Recruitment Notes

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. We are a remote-first, global team and do not accept unsolicited agency resumes. We may request a short video response or review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. Due to high application volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. No agencies or recruiters, please.

Nice to Have: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line tools; Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications.

We’re looking for a leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment and embodies our values. We provide a comprehensive total rewards package, including ownership via equity and remote work flexibility (up to 180 days per year, subject to restrictions). title: Senior Creative Performance Strategist
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and earned Forbes 30 Under 30 recognition for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

The Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but hyper-focused on paid media.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service, an AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance — combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

What You’ll Do

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.
  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.
  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.
  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.
  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display platforms.
  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.
  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative — including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video — with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and platform-specific best practices.
  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output, including ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, and more.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability to performance results.
  • Skilled at working with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.
  • Comfortable communicating in English with internal teams and clients, including presenting creative work and responding to feedback clearly and professionally.
  • Confident giving constructive feedback to other designers and supporting their growth through clear direction and mentorship.
  • Able to take ambiguous campaign goals and turn them into creative concepts that are visually engaging and conversion-focused.
  • Proficient in Figma for ad design workflows; knowledge of Auto Layout, Components, and asset handoff is essential.
  • Experience using Adobe Creative Suite (especially Photoshop and Illustrator) for asset creation and layout design.
  • Bonus: Experience designing high-performing ads for e-commerce brands, familiarity with motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere), or working with UGC creators and editors.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

Location and benefits — Remote-first culture with hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona; flexible parental leave benefits; opportunities for cross-functional growth and collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

  • Full-time

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.

What We Offer

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the entire user experience, from initial concept to final visual design. By turning customer insights into impactful and aesthetically pleasing designs, you’ll make our products more intuitive, self-servicing, and valuable.   • Conduct 3 customer interviews with a Product Manager weekly to gather actionable feedback for design improvements.

What we’re looking for

  • Extremely curious and inquisitive, with a passion for understanding user needs.

  • Proven expertise in UI design, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work with design systems, mockups, and prototypes.
  • Quick learner who can master the industry and product in a short time.
  • Extensive knowledge of design principles, UX/UI best practices, and proficiency in modern design tools.
  • Relentless work ethic: willing to go the extra mile (10+ hours daily when needed).
  • No ego and a mindset of continuous learning and collaboration.
  • Builds genuine relationships with team members and customers.
  • Positive, motivating, and supportive team player.
  • Accountable for successes and failures, with a focus on doing the job right.
  • Balances leadership with hands-on contributions (player-coach mentality).
  • Passionate about AI and its potential to transform industries

What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.

Why Join XILO?

Be part of a mission-driven team at the forefront of AI innovation and SaaS technology. As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll have the opportunity to own the user experience and interface of a cutting-edge platform, deliver career-defining work, and make a lasting impact on a rapidly growing company.

At XILO, we don’t stop until the job is done. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves, embrace challenges, and make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you.

description:
Overview

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate supports end users, manages endpoints, automates identity and access management, and administers cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated prior success in similar roles within rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is excited to design, implement and manage our growing cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be a strong communicator and fast learner, seeking a supportive environment to grow your IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

What You’ll Do / Responsibilities

  • Be customer-facing and the first line of support for employees via Slack, Jira, and other channels.
  • Pro­cure and deliver technology equipment and own the tech onboarding and offboarding experience.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Improve IDP and SSO tooling (GSuite, Okta, etc.) and document solutions; automate routine work.
  • Lead incident response for critical issues and manage tickets with prioritization and escalation as needed.
  • Work on projects across sprints with agile methodologies and track work in Jira.
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using Bash, Zsh, Python, etc.; experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and building workflows; strong API integration skills.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; capable of hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Proficiency in security practices, PGP basics, networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing/switching); methodical troubleshooting following OSI layers.
  • Self-management skills to scope projects and work across multiple teams.

Nice to Have / Preferred Qualifications

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience using GAM and CLI for efficiency.
  • Jamf, Okta, and Google Workspace certifications.

Culture & Fit

  • Leadership mindset suitable for a startup/tech environment; values-focused with empathy and integrity.
  • Ability to work remotely and navigate ambiguity in a high-growth setting.

Benefits & Responsibilities of Belonging

  • Competitive total rewards package starting from day one, including a PTO package and ownership through equity.
  • Remote work opportunity worldwide for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • Purpose-driven work in a global digital asset company; commitment to inclusivity and diversity.

Equality & Recruitment Notes

Ledn is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. If accommodation is needed during the recruitment process, please email the Ledn team with your request; all inquiries are confidential. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes, and we are not responsible for fees related to them.

Empowered to think big. Try new opportunities while working with a talented, ambitious and supportive team.

Transformational and proactive working environment. Elevate employees to find thoughtful and innovative solutions.

Why Binance

title: Tech manager
description:
Sobre a Lemon

As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta.

A Lemon é o jeito mais simples para empresas e pessoas impactarem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de uma energia mais barata e limpa. Entregamos uma energia diferente da tradicional, por isso conseguimos oferecer uma conta de luz mais econômica e sustentável. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, por isso garantimos sempre um atendimento mais próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico.

Somos apoiados pelos principais investidores em tecnologia de todo o mundo, incluindo fundos de venture capital como Kaszek, Lowercarbon Capital, Canary, Big Bets e Actyus. Endereçar um dos desafios mais significativos do mundo requer pensamento inovador e perspectivas diversas. Estamos construindo um time de pessoas com diferentes experiências, repertório profissional e formações educacionais. Se você compartilha da nossa paixão de criar essa a nova era da energia limpa, estamos ansiosos para conhecer o que de único você traz para Lemon.

Saiba mais sobre a Lemon

Sobre o Time De Tech

O time de Tecnologia da Lemon é o coração da nossa inovação e crescimento. Nossa tecnologia é criada e mantida por times multidisciplinares e somos responsáveis por desenvolver soluções escaláveis e eficientes que impulsionam a nossa missão de revolucionar o setor de energia limpa. Trabalhamos em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde a criatividade e a excelência técnica são valorizadas. No nosso backend usamos principalmente aws com node.js e microsserviços orientados a eventos assíncronos. Nosso principal banco de dados é o DynamoDB. Toda a nossa infra é serverless e criada como código. Usamos jest e github actions para nossos testes e deploys. Saiba mais sobre a nossa stack aqui.

Se você deseja fazer parte de uma equipe que está na vanguarda da tecnologia e contribuir para um futuro mais sustentável, a Lemon é o lugar certo para você.

O Que Você Vai Fazer

  • Ter a chance real de participar da formação de uma empresa unicórnio;
  • Fazer a diferença em uma empresa que tem um dos maiores potenciais do mercado brasileiro atualmente;
  • Conseguir aplicar soluções tecnológicas que impactam positivamente o meio onde vivemos;
  • Liderar a direção técnica do time, garantindo a aplicação das melhores práticas e padrões de qualidade;
  • Representar o time de engenharia em discussões estratégicas e processos de tomada de decisão;
  • Supervisionar a arquitetura e o design de sistemas complexos, assegurando escalabilidade, estabilidade e custos;
  • Ser responsável pela formação e times de alta performance na área de tecnologia.
O Perfil Que Buscamos

  • Pró-atividade para resolver desafios complexos e muita vontade de fazer acontecer, passividade não faz parte deste perfil;
  • Capacidade de inspirar e motivar o time, direcionando-o para a excelência e inovação;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, com capacidade de articular conceitos técnicos para partes interessadas não técnicas;
  • Mentalidade de ownership: responsabilidade pelo que constrói e mantém;
  • Flexibilidade para trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e de mudanças frequentes (somos uma startup);
  • Conexão com o impacto de negócio e entendimento do porquê por trás das soluções;
  • Comunicação clara, respeitosa e madura, com abertura para dar e receber feedback;
  • Empatia para trabalhar bem com pessoas de diferentes áreas e perfis;
  • Compromisso com o próprio desenvolvimento contínuo.
Experiência Prévia / Habilidades Exigidas

  • Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Mínimo de 2 anos atuando como líder ténico;
  • Mínimo de 2 anos de Experiência em gestão de pessoas e desenvolvimento de equipes de tecnologia;
  • Experiência comprovada na entrega de projetos de larga escala e alto impacto;
  • Forte compreensão dos princípios de desenvolvimento de software, incluindo DDD, microservices e arquiteturas baseadas em cloud;
  • Habilidade para equilibrar excelência técnica com pragmatismo e entrega de valor ao negócio.
Será Um Diferencial Se Você Já Tiver Conhecimentos Em (Não Esperamos Que Você Já Conheça Tudo Isso, Procuramos Pessoas Curiosas e Que Estejam Dispostas a Aprender)

  • Experiência no setor de energia e/ou em startups de rápido crescimento;
  • Conhecimento em Node.js e React;
  • Familiaridade com tecnologias de cloud computing, especialmente AWS;

O Que a Gente Oferece

  • Trabalho remoto;
  • Materiais de escritório;
  • Coworking em todo o país;
  • Cartão Caju flexível (pode ser usado nas categorias alimentação, refeição, mobilidade, educação, saúde e cultura);

Pesquisas mostram que pessoas que se identificam como homens candidatam-se a um trabalho quando consideram que cumprem 60% dos requisitos, já pessoas que se identificam como mulheres e outros grupos minorizados tendem a aplicar apenas quando preenchem todos os requisitos possíveis. Então, se você acredita que possui habilidades para mudar o futuro da energia no país com a gente, mas não necessariamente preenche tudo listado acima, por favor prossiga na vaga. Adoraríamos bater um papo e descobrir se você é quem estamos procurando.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Aqui na Lemon a diversidade é um compromisso ético e, por isso, estamos engajados para nos tornarmos uma empresa cada vez mais diversa e caso se sinta confortável, gostaríamos de saber na sua candidatura se auto identifica/declara pertencente a algum ou alguns grupos de diversidade.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
About Ledn

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role & Responsibilities

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You’ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You’ll balance help desk tickets and prioritize them. You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints). You’ll set and work to your own objectives and key results with minimal direction, and align them to the team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You know how to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs and integrate one system to another.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries and time zones; familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across all media; able to explain ideas clearly and help users calmly.
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others; you take security seriously and know what PGP is.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. Familiar with OSI model troubleshooting steps. Ability to self-manage and scope projects across multiple teams.

Nice to Have & Culture

  • Some familiarity with AWS; used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: a leader who thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies Ledn values.
  • Builder’s mindset, adaptability, resilience, and comfort navigating ambiguity in a high-growth environment.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive total rewards package, with equity and remote work options up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company.
  • Remote-first environment with global team.
  • Purpose-driven career and inclusive, diverse culture. Equal opportunity employer; accommodation requests can be made confidentially.

Other Information

  • Ledn is a global, remote-first company with team members across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.
  • Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted.
  • As part of the selection process, candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role.
  • No agencies or recruiters; we do not accept unsolicited resumes or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

description:
Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is seeking an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, while also helping end users.

We are a global financial services company built for digital assets, delivering lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. Our team is passionate, diverse, and committed to democratizing access to the global economy through Ledn’s products and services.

The role reports to the Director of IT.

The Opportunity

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. You will be customer-facing, the first line of support; you own support and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees via Slack, Jira, etc.

Key responsibilities include:

  • You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.
  • You will own the onboarding experience for all new employees and the retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools; contribute improvements to knowledge bases.
  • You will support and manage SaaS applications such as Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • You will manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • You will own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • You will detail solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and resolve critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • Balance help desk tickets while prioritising effectively and work on projects over sprints with Jira and agile methods.
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open-source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta.
  • Experience with APIs and integrating systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across media; ability to explain complex topics clearly and calmly.
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email, Slack; clear, friendly, concise communication with cultural sensitivity.
  • A commitment to security, including knowledge of PGP.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching).
  • Ability to methodically troubleshoot problems using OSI layers; capable of self-management and prioritising across multiple teams.
  • Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfortable dealing with ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

Nice To Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; prior usage is acceptable without certifications.
  • Experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to improve efficiency.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • We look for more than operational excellence — a leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment and embodies our values.
  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Builder's mindset; excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Collaborative partner capable of influencing across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability in handling confidential information across diverse contexts.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Growth opportunities as part of Ledn, a leading digital asset company.
  • Comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one, with a competitive PTO package.
  • Ownership in the company through equity; remote work flexibility up to 180 days globally (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven career and a support-focused work environment.
  • Equal opportunity employment; commitment to inclusivity and diversity.

Ledn is a remote-first, global team spanning North America, Latin America, Africa and Europe.

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN

The Opportunity: We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is a highly motivated, dependable technologist who wants to be part of a fast moving and execution-oriented team.

The role involves designing, implementing and managing our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks; collaborating with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering, HR); and being a strong communicator and fast learner in a supportive environment for IT growth. This role reports to the Director of IT.

Overview

You will be customer-facing, the first line of support, own support, and provide an outstanding experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We primarily work on Mac environments. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment and will own the onboarding and offboarding tech experience. You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and Mac endpoint/mobile device management. You will work on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.), document solutions, and automate routine tasks. You will manage incidents, juggle help desk tickets, and participate in projects over sprints with Jira and Agile methods. You will set and pursue objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.

Responsibilities

  • Provide end-user support and own the employee technology experience (Mac-focused environment).
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; manage onboarding and offboarding processes.
  • Design, test, build, and document IT programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to knowledge base.
  • Manage SaaS applications: Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • Administer Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf, etc.).
  • Manage identity and access, IDP/SSO integrations (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Write clear solutions and help articles; automate routine tasks.
  • Lead and participate in projects with Agile methods and Jira tracking.
  • Handle critical incidents and issues to resolution; prioritize help desk tickets effectively.
  • Collaborate with Cybersecurity/IT peers and cross-functional teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering, HR).

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations (bash, zsh, Python) and use open source tooling (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and building workflows; API integration between systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; knowledge of hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; ability to convey ideas clearly and empathetically.
  • Security awareness, basic networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing/switching) and OSI troubleshooting methodology.
  • Self-management skills with ability to scope projects, prioritize, and work across multiple teams.
  • Willingness to work in a remote-first environment and adapt to ambiguity in a high-growth setting.
  • Nice to have: AWS familiarity; GAM, command-line fluency; Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications.

Benefits & Culture

  • Comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one.
  • Competitive PTO and ownership through equity; remote work up to 180 days worldwide (subject to restrictions).
  • Purpose-driven work in a global, remote-first company; emphasis on inclusivity and diversity.
  • Accommodation for recruitment process available; confidential handling of requests.
